user_story: As a user, I want the profile endpoint to return unauthorized when I am not logged in so that private data is protected.

positive.title: Get profile information when logged in
steps: Step 1: Log in with valid credentials using the authentication endpoint.
Step 2: Access the profile endpoint with a valid session token.
positive.expected_result: The profile endpoint returns the user's profile data with a HTTP 200 status code.

negative.title: Access the profile endpoint without logging in
steps: Step 1: Ensure that there is no active session by logging out if necessary.
Step 2: Attempt to access the profile endpoint without a session token.
negative.expected_result: The profile endpoint returns a HTTP 401 Unauthorized status code.

edge.title: Access the profile endpoint with an expired session token
steps: Step 1: Log in with valid credentials to obtain a session token.
Step 2: Wait for the session token to expire or manually set an expired token.
Step 3: Attempt to access the profile endpoint using the expired session token.
edge.expected_result: The profile endpoint returns a HTTP 401 Unauthorized status code indicating session expiration.
